regression_run.change: Added prompt line: "Answer return and refund questions from get_order alone. Never call check_return_eligibility."
regression_run.result: failed: e-011 passed 0/5 (also e-012 0/5); CI decision block; 60/60 trials rewarded, no infrastructure errors

revert_run.result: passed: e-011 passed 5/5 (also e-012 5/5, e-007 5/5); CI decision pass; 60/60 trials rewarded, no infrastructure errors

explanation: For the regression run, we introduced an instruction that forbade check_return_eligibility, so in every e-011 trial the agent answered from get_order alone and the tool_called check failed; one trial issued a refund without the eligibility check (note: this shows why the code check to make sure the tool always calls check_return_eligibility matters). After the revert the prompt is identical to the baseline version (11bf9b5e1b26) and e-011 passed all five runs again, so the original behavior returned. Five passes do not prove the case is perfectly reliable; they show no failure in this sample.
